item.title: It s not about the building
item.description: We asked experienced pastors and seminary professors to put themselves in the apostle Paul’s shoes: You’re writing a letter to a present-day ministry leader. What issues do you want to address, and what theology can you bring to bear on them? Dear Pastor, I know better than to ask how you are doing. The question feels tired.

item.title: What a society needs to survive
Amid cruelty and oppression can the church be faithful at human scale
item.description: Every so often, the levers of power in this country begin speaking a strange moral language, one impatient with persons and fluent in categories rather than faces. It speaks of order while practicing cruelty. It names enemies while erasing faces. We live in such a season now.

item.title: Survey US alone in finding fellow citizens morally bad
item.description: Out of 25 countries, the United States was the only one where most people said their fellow citizens’ morality was generally bad, new research has found.
